title: Beal Conjecture
statusZh: 开放 · AMS 管理的 100 万美元奖金
author: Andrew Beal

overview.summary: Can three pairwise collectively coprime bases support an equality of perfect powers with every exponent greater than two? OPBench turns a counterexample into six integers checked with exact arithmetic.
overview.summaryZh: 三个没有共同素因子的底数能否在所有指数均大于二时构成幂等式？OPBench 将反例化为六个可精确运算核验的整数。

visualization.label: Exact powers constrained by a shared prime
visualization.labelZh: 共同素因子约束下的精确幂等式
visualization.caption: Known solutions such as 27 + 216 = 243 share a prime factor; a counterexample must make the common gcd equal to one.
visualization.captionZh: 已知解如 27 + 216 = 243 具有共同素因子；反例必须使三个底数的共同最大公因数为 1。

statement.intro: For positive integers with all exponents greater than two,
statement.introZh: 对于正整数且所有指数均大于二，
statement.explanation: the conjecture states that $A$, $B$, and $C$ must have a common prime factor. A counterexample must additionally satisfy $\gcd(A,B,C)=1$.
statement.explanationZh: 猜想断言 $A$、$B$、$C$ 必有共同素因子。反例还必须满足 $\gcd(A,B,C)=1$。
statement.note: The verifier uses arbitrary-precision integer exponentiation and gcd; there is no numerical tolerance and no model-based grading.
statement.noteZh: 验证器使用任意精度整数幂与最大公因数运算，不设数值容差，也不使用模型评分。

atlas.title: A Fermat-type frontier with a standing prize
atlas.titleZh: 设有长期奖金的 Fermat 型前沿
atlas.body: The statement generalizes the exponent pattern behind Fermat's Last Theorem while allowing three different exponents.
atlas.bodyZh: 该命题推广 Fermat 大定理背后的指数结构，并允许三个指数彼此不同。

events.title: Andrew Beal formulates the conjecture
events.description: Beal states the common-prime-factor obstruction while investigating Fermat-type equations.
events.descriptionZh: Beal 在研究 Fermat 型方程时提出共同素因子障碍。

events.title: The conjecture and prize are announced through the AMS
events.titleZh: 猜想与奖金通过 AMS 公布
events.description: The Notices of the AMS introduces the problem and its publication-based award process.
events.descriptionZh: 《AMS Notices》介绍该问题及以正式发表为前提的奖励流程。

events.title: The prize fund reaches US$1,000,000
events.description: An AMS-appointed committee administers the award for a refereed proof or counterexample.
events.descriptionZh: AMS 任命的委员会负责评审经同行评议发表的证明或反例。

events.title: The conjecture remains open
events.description: No accepted coprime-base solution or proof is known; finite proposed tuples remain exactly testable.
events.descriptionZh: 尚无获认可的互素底数解或完整证明，但任意有限候选六元组均可精确核验。

frontier.title: The coprime perfect-power frontier
frontier.summary: The conjecture remains open. A finite candidate is unusually audit-friendly: six integers determine the entire claim, and exact exponentiation together with one gcd calculation decides every declared condition.
frontier.summaryZh: 猜想仍未解决。有限候选却尤其适合审计：六个整数即可确定完整主张，精确幂运算与一次最大公因数计算便能判定全部声明条件。

facts.label: KNOWN SOLUTIONS
facts.text: Equalities such as $3^3+6^3=3^5$ satisfy the power equation only with a shared prime factor; no accepted gcd-one tuple is known.
facts.textZh: $3^3+6^3=3^5$ 等等式虽然满足幂方程，却含有共同素因子；目前没有获认可的最大公因数为 1 的六元组。

facts.label: FINITE VERDICT
facts.text: For any submitted six-tuple, positivity, exponent bounds, the common gcd, exact equality, and integer residual can all be computed without numerical tolerance.
facts.textZh: 对于任意提交的六元组，正整数性、指数下界、共同最大公因数、精确等式与整数残差均可在无数值容差的条件下计算。

benchmark.name: OPBench · Beal Counterexample Search
benchmark.title: One exact counterexample search
benchmark.body: The benchmark asks for one coprime-base perfect-power equality and checks every arithmetic condition exactly.
benchmark.bodyZh: 评测要求构造一道底数无共同素因子的完全幂等式，并精确检查每项算术条件。
benchmark.hintNote: This open problem is evaluated without hints.
benchmark.hintNoteZh: 该开放问题统一采用无提示评测。
benchmark.footer: A strict pass requires positive bases, exponents greater than two, a common gcd of one, and exact equality.
benchmark.footerZh: 严格通过要求底数为正、指数大于二、三个底数的共同最大公因数为一，并且等式精确成立。

tasks.title: Coprime-base Counterexample
tasks.subtitle: Six integers · exact equality
tasks.subtitleZh: 六个整数 · 精确等式
tasks.significance: A passing tuple would disprove the Beal Conjecture and qualify for deterministic checking.
tasks.significanceZh: 通过的六元组将反驳 Beal 猜想，并可被确定性程序核验。
tasks.questionZh: 构造一个整数六元组 $(A,B,C,x,y,z)$：三个底数均为正整数，三个指数均大于 2，$\gcd(A,B,C)=1$，并且精确满足 $A^x+B^y=C^z$。

evaluation.title: Condition-level arithmetic verdicts
evaluation.body: Parsing, positivity, exponent bounds, gcd, and exact equality are shown as separate deterministic verdicts.
evaluation.bodyZh: 解析、正整数、指数范围、最大公因数与精确等式均以独立的确定性结论展示。

symbolicLab.title: Test a candidate solution interactively
symbolicLab.body: Enter A, B, C, x, y, and z. The browser checks every declared Beal constraint with exact integer arithmetic; it does not use an LLM judge or assess novelty.
symbolicLab.bodyZh: 输入 A、B、C、x、y、z。浏览器以精确整数运算逐项检查 Beal 约束；不使用 LLM judge，也不判断创新性。
symbolicLab.outputFormat:
OUTPUT:
{"A": <positive integer>, "B": <positive integer>, "C": <positive integer>, "x": <integer > 2>, "y": <integer > 2>, "z": <integer > 2>}

SOLUTION:
<exact derivation and verification>
